offering_description.value: Envista sells dental implants, orthodontic appliances, imaging and scanning systems, and clinical supplies to dental practices, specialists, and laboratories. It develops and manufactures dental products and digital workflow tools and sells them through its sales teams and dental dealers.

primary_products.value: Dental implants and prosthetics; clear aligners and braces; dental imaging systems and intraoral scanners; dental planning and imaging software; restorative, endodontic, and infection-control supplies

primary_services.value: Clinical training and continuing education; dental imaging equipment maintenance and repair

customer_segment.value: B2B: General dentists, orthodontists, oral surgeons, periodontists, dental laboratories, dental service organizations, and dental dealers

end_markets.value: Implant dentistry; orthodontics; general and restorative dentistry; endodontics; dental laboratories

revenue_model.value: product sales: Implants, orthodontic appliances, imaging equipment, scanners, and replenishable dental supplies; service fees: Clinical courses and dental imaging equipment service plans

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns purchased materials and components into dental devices and supplies for clinicians, laboratories, and dealers; software / platform: Processes dental scans and images for clinicians and laboratories to plan treatment and design restorations; service provider: Uses clinical instructors and technical specialists to train dental teams and maintain imaging equipment
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, the Middle East, and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: Implant systems, orthodontic appliances, dental imaging and scanning, clinical software, and dental consumables

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Specialty sales teams serving implant clinicians, orthodontists, and dental groups; distributors / dealers: Dental dealers supplying practices and laboratories with imaging equipment and consumables; online: Company ordering portals for dental professionals purchasing implants, components, and orthodontic supplies

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Dental implants, orthodontic devices, and imaging systems are subject to FDA medical device requirements and the EU Medical Device Regulation

notes: The scope of paid training and equipment service plans may vary by market.
